decisions.statement: Northwind Labs provides full-time staff with 20 days of paid leave per year under version 3 of the leave policy.
quotes: Full-time staff get 20 days of paid leave per year.

decisions.statement: Northwind Labs does not allow unused paid leave days to carry over to the next year.
quotes: Unused days do not carry over.

facts.statement: The leave policy version 3 becomes effective on 1 March 2026.
